$comment: Plain-English definitions for every term used anywhere in this section. Rendered by rushroyale.js on glossary.html with shape 'terms'. One sentence each — if a term needs a paragraph it belongs on a page, and the 'see' link should point there. Keep entries alphabetical by name; the renderer preserves file order. Fields: name, def, see {text, href}, tags.

entries.name: Arena
entries.def: The bracket your PvP rating puts you in; climbing arenas introduces new enemy types, such as the Virus boss from arena 7 and the Assassin from arena 9.

entries.name: Artifact
entries.def: An ability you can equip to a deck, unlocked by raising your Legendarity.

entries.name: Board
entries.def: The 3×5 grid of tiles you place units on — fifteen tiles, and no more, which is why merging exists.

entries.name: Bedlam
entries.def: One of the named bosses — the example most often used when explaining that a boss arrives with health equal to the damage your opponent dealt to their Phantom.

entries.name: Boss
entries.def: A heavy enemy that spawns on your board with health equal to the damage your opponent dealt to their Phantom — so how hard a boss you face is set by how hard they hit.

entries.name: Carry
entries.def: The single damage unit a deck is built around; the other four cards exist to raise its damage and attack speed so it hits the Phantom as hard as possible.

entries.name: Clan
entries.def: A group of players who chat, request cards from each other, and enter clan-only content together.

entries.name: Clan Tournament
entries.def: A four-phase event: one week to set your PvP rating, division assignment based on it, then clans meeting head to head.

entries.name: Co-op
entries.def: Two players against waves of AI enemies, with one usually playing damage and the other support.

entries.name: Crowd control
entries.def: Anything that slows, stuns or otherwise delays enemies instead of damaging them — buying your damage dealers time.

entries.name: Deck
entries.def: The five cards you bring to a match; every unit you summon is drawn at random from these five.

entries.name: Dragon Rift
entries.def: Clan PvE across a series of worlds, where members' cumulative wins wear down a dragon's health until the clan can move on.

entries.name: Expedition
entries.def: A passive, always-running source of hero fragments that can turn up legendary heroes for gold.

entries.name: Experiment Coins
entries.def: A narrow currency from the premium season pass, spent in its own shop section.

entries.name: Faction
entries.def: A grouping of units that certain item bonuses apply to; a faction bonus does nothing if your deck has no units in that faction.

entries.name: Fragments
entries.def: Per-thing crafting material — 200 item fragments of a slot's type plus gold makes that item, and hero fragments unlock and level heroes.

entries.name: Gems
entries.def: The premium currency, also called crystals; earnable for free through achievements, quests and ads, or buyable.

entries.name: Gold
entries.def: The everyday currency, spent on card levels, chests, equipment and hero levels.

entries.name: Gate
entries.def: The point an enemy reaches if your board fails to kill it; anything arriving there costs you hearts.

entries.name: Heart
entries.def: Your health in a match. You start with 3: an ordinary monster reaching the gate costs 1 and a boss costs 2, so three common leaks or two boss leaks end the match.

entries.name: Legendarity
entries.def: An account-wide stat calculated from the levels of your legendary units and heroes, which unlocks the spells and artifacts a deck can equip.

entries.name: Magic Dust
entries.def: An uncapped material you bank up and trade in at the store — 1,000 dust for one random legendary card.

entries.name: Magic Orbs
entries.def: The upgrade material every legendary level needs alongside duplicate cards — the real reason legendaries level slowly.

entries.name: Mana
entries.def: What you spend to summon units and to upgrade them mid-match; you start a match with 100 and earn more by killing things.

entries.name: Merge
entries.def: Combining two identical units of the same rank into one unit of the next rank, drawn at random from your deck — it frees a tile but gives up a body.

entries.name: Mirror Decks
entries.def: A PvP variant where both players use the same pre-assembled deck, so the match is decided by play rather than collection.

entries.name: Phantom
entries.def: Appears on your board at the end of every wave; the damage your units deal to it is sent to your opponent as the health of the boss they must kill — which makes your damage output your attack, not just your defence.

entries.name: Rank
entries.def: A unit's level on the board, raised by merging. Distinct from card level, which is permanent and raised outside a match.

entries.name: Rarity
entries.def: Common, Rare, Epic or Legendary. It controls which chests a card appears in and what it costs to upgrade — not how good the card is.

entries.name: Rune Key
entries.def: Earned by levelling the season pass, and spent on chests in the Seasonal Items store — including the one that pays magic dust.

entries.name: Rush for Glory
entries.def: A PvP variant where you build a deck and pick a hero by repeatedly choosing from three random options.

entries.name: Spell
entries.def: An ability you can equip to a deck and use in battle, unlocked through Legendarity.

entries.name: Summoner
entries.def: A legendary support unit that, on merging, drops a random unit from your deck onto a free tile at a rank between 1 and its own merge rank.

entries.name: Talent
entries.def: An unlockable upgrade for a card, tied to your Legendarity progression, that you level to stay competitive.

entries.name: Trophies
entries.def: Your PvP rating — it decides your arena and therefore what you face, and is not spent on anything.

entries.name: Wave
entries.def: One batch of enemies. What spawns in each wave is not documented here yet; what matters is that the Phantom appears at the end of one.
